{"type":"thought","data":"Researching the Sassuolo"}
{"type":"thought","data":" vs Lazio match scheduled"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for October 27, 2026."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.265 implies roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a 26.5% draw probability,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which aligns with typical"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Serie A draw rates "}
{"type":"thought","data":"near 25-30%. A successful"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes bet would yield"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about 377 tokens and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a profit of approximately"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 277."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA No bet would yield"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 136 tokens "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and a profit of about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 36. The user wants "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the outcome most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off, which means"}
{"type":"thought","data":" choosing the side with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the highest expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value or probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of winning."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe user's prior record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows they often pick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the favorite and have"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lost several times "}
{"type":"thought","data":"on draw outcomes. Expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value calculations "}
{"type":"thought","data":"reveal that both sides"}
{"type":"thought","data":" break even at a 26.5%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw probability. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" key is to identify "}
{"type":"thought","data":"whether the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" differs significantly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from that market price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" is ambiguous."}
{"type":"thought","data":" It could mean the outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" most likely to be correct,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which would favor No"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 73.5%, or it could"}
{"type":"thought","data":" mean the side with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the highest expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" return, which would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favor Yes at 26.5%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This is a single-round"}
{"type":"thought","data":" competition where the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goal is to maximize"}
{"type":"thought","data":" profit and P&L against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" other agents."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nIf all agents place"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the same bet, the round"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ends in a tie. To actually"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win against the other"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agents, I must either"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pick the correct side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" when they pick wrong,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or ensure my P&L beats"}
{"type":"thought","data":" theirs. At a true draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability near 26%,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" betting No wins roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 74% of the time with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only a 36 token profit."}

{"type":"thought","data":"I need more specific"}
{"type":"thought","data":" information about the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Sassuolo versus Lazio"}
{"type":"thought","data":" match."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.265 for a draw is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" slightly above the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"consensus estimate of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 23% to 27% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"from sportsbooks and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" AI models. This suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the prediction market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may be overpricing "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the draw."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.265 is actually very"}
{"type":"thought","data":" close to the fair draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability after removing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" vig, suggesting the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market is efficient"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with no clear edge."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I need to determine"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which outcome will "}
{"type":"thought","data":"most likely pay off "}
{"type":"thought","data":"in this competition."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe competition is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a head-to-head against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" three other agents."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The goal is to be the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" only correct predictor"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or tie with them. A"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lone correct pick wins"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outright, while ties"}
{"type":"thought","data":" split the payout."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe most likely correct"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome is No, with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 73% probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This is the safest "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bet to pay off."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirm a slight edge"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to No. Betting on the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw yields roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" negative 2 tokens, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"while betting against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the draw yields about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" positive 1 token. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" supports choosing No"}
{"type":"thought","data":" as the most likely "}
{"type":"thought","data":"outcome to pay off."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI recall losing to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draws in tighter matches,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but this gap is severe."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Lazio is unbeaten at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 22 points while Sassuolo"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sits at 8. Sports Mole"}
{"type":"thought","data":" predicts a 2-2 draw,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Sassuolo has been"}
{"type":"thought","data":" unbeaten at home."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nLazio is heavily favored"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with a moneyline around"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +105 and four consecutive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" away wins. Sassuolo"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has scored in all eight"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matches, so games tend"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to have goals on both"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sides. Football Whispers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" predicts a 1-2 Lazio"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win. Despite the draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rate being historically"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near 27%, the odds "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and recent form favor"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a Lazio victory."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nLazio's 16 goals for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and 5 against contrast"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sharply with Sassuolo's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 12 for and 16 against."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The over 2.5 line is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favored at roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"57 to 60 percent, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" slightly reduces the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw probability. Public"}
{"type":"thought","data":" betting heavily favors"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Lazio."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nHistorical head-to-head"}
{"type":"thought","data":" data shows Lazio has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" won 14 of the last "}
{"type":"thought","data":"24 Serie A meetings,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with only four draws."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Sassuolo has won just"}
{"type":"thought","data":" one of the last twelve"}
{"type":"thought","data":" home games against "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Lazio. Combined, this"}
{"type":"thought","data":" match appears less "}
{"type":"thought","data":"likely to end in a draw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than the average Serie"}
{"type":"thought","data":" A fixture."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA Poisson model using"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected goals of roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 1.6 for Lazio and 1.1"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for Sassuolo suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a draw probability "}
{"type":"thought","data":"near 23 percent. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" aligns with the sportsbook"}
{"type":"thought","data":" consensus and supports"}
{"type":"thought","data":" betting against the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI am weighing the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"competition structure."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If other agents also"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pick No, a correct "}
{"type":"thought","data":"draw bet would tie with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" them and split the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"payout. A lone Yes bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" could win big if it"}
{"type":"thought","data":" hits. But if I bet "}
{"type":"thought","data":"No and the match ends"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in a draw, I lose while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" they tie. If I bet "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Yes and the match does"}
{"type":"thought","data":" not end in a draw, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"I lose while they gain."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This tournament dynamic"}
{"type":"thought","data":" changes the optimal"}
{"type":"thought","data":" strategy."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe user's goal is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to maximize individual"}
{"type":"thought","data":" profit, not to outsmart"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the other agents. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prior record shows "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a grind strategy of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"small wins and occasional"}
{"type":"thought","data":" losses. This suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" betting on the higher"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability side is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the correct approach."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe agent's prior "}
{"type":"thought","data":"draw bets were mostly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" correct. They won on"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No in Santa Clara versus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Benfica and Galatasaray"}
{"type":"thought","data":" versus Fenerbahce. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"They lost only on Verona"}
{"type":"thought","data":" versus Pisa and Sunderland"}
{"type":"thought","data":" versus Leeds. This "}
{"type":"thought","data":"track record supports"}
{"type":"thought","data":" betting against the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe agent's prior "}
{"type":"thought","data":"draw bets were mixed."}
{"type":"thought","data":" They won four times"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but lost three, with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payouts near 0.71 to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.74. This match is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" different: Lazio is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a clear favorite visiting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Sassuolo. The base "}

\n\n[Lazio](/football/lazio/) \n\n# Preview: Sassuolo vs Lazio - prediction, team news, lineups\n\nBy [Jonathan O'Shea](/team/jonathan-oshea/) | 25 Oct 2026 07:51 \n\n![Sassuolo vs Lazio - prediction, team news, lineups](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/hIBe7Mo82b_3MHS7rjqTyGSQmAs=/720x540/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fimago1083683346h-1-6ac899c6481a0970942711.jpg) \n\n© Imago / IPA Sport\n\n[Lazio](/football/lazio/ \"Lazio\") will look to extend their stunning start to the season on Tuesday evening, when they visit an ailing [Sassuolo](/football/sassuolo/ \"Sassuolo\") side in [**Serie A**](/football/serie-a/table.html).\n\nThe Biancocelesti are unbeaten in their first eight league games for the first time since the 1999-00 campaign, which they memorably ended by lifting the Scudetto.\n\n* * *\n\n## Match preview\n\nWith the Serie A summit up for grabs, Lazio went top of the pile on Saturday night, moving above defending champions Inter Milan with yet another home win.\n\nAfter the record-breaking Biancocelesti had beaten Juventus 3-0 in Turin, they conquered lowly Parma in Rome, with a 2-1 victory taking them onto 22 points from eight games.\n\nAlmost everything is going right at both ends of the pitch: [Gennaro Gattuso](/people/gennaro-gattuso/ \"Gennaro Gattuso\")’s side have scored at least twice in each of the last six, while only Inter have hit the woodwork more often.\n\nFurthermore, they are the only team yet to concede a first-half goal across all of Europe's top five leagues, [**and they boast the best defensive record in Italy’s top flight**](/football/serie-a/#stats).\n\nBefore heading to Reggio-Emilia, the last time Lazio failed to win on the road was May’s Derby della Capitale defeat to Roma - and they have won four of their last six Serie A meetings with Sassuolo.\n\n![](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/_rqmCP7lieCeg-vrHpnxzVV9rAs=/640x480/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F08%2Fimago1081250242-1-6a881ba61a945168428900.jpg)\n\n© Imago / IPA Sport\n\nIf that were not enough to dishearten the Neroverdi, taking just one point from their last four matches may not help. \n\nFollowing a 4-2 defeat to newly promoted Frosinone and Saturday’s 2-0 reverse in Como, Sassuolo have slipped closer to the drop zone, with only eight points on the board so far.\n\nWhile few teams can deal with Como’s fluent football, the visitors attempted a mere seven shots at Stadio Sinigaglia, none of which found the target.\n\nSassuolo have also failed to keep a clean sheet in Serie A, so aside from a Coppa Italia run - they will meet Juventus for a last-16 tie in December - [Alberto Aquilani](/people/alberto-aquilani/ \"Alberto Aquilani\")'s reign has been a little below par.\n\nSince taking charge, he has yet to register an away win - and the Neroverdi’s winless streak on the road dates back 11 games overall - but Aquilani’s side are still undefeated at home.\n\nSassuolo Serie A form:\n\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/bologna-vs-sassuolo_game_257276.html \"Bologna 2 - 2 Sassuolo\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/sassuolo-vs-juventus_game_257961.html \"Sassuolo 3 - 2 Juventus\")\n* competitions):\n\n*   [D](/football/serie-a/bologna-vs-sassuolo_game_257276.html \"Bologna 2 - 2 Sassuolo\")\n*   [W](/football/serie-a/sassuolo-vs-juventus_game_257961.html \"Sassuolo 3 - 2 News\n\n![Davide Frattesi of Lazio - August 24, 2026](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/EOriWA48FcjYUzZD9kXTmaEmBgs=/640x480/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F08%2Fimago1082030247-1-6a913b059e261160948436.jpg)\n\n© Imago / Gribaudi/ImagePhoto  \n Lazio were already missing Albert Gudmundsson with a dislocated shoulder, before fellow forward Andrea Pinamonti - signed from Sassuolo this summer - was ruled out of Saturday’s game by a fever.\n\nIt remains to be seen if either will be ready to play at the Mapei Stadium, while Adam Marusic and Nicolo Rovella could also miss out.\n\nAfter scoring the opener against Parma, and ending a 13-game goal drought in Serie A, Kenneth Taylor should join former Sassuolo star [Davide Frattesi](/people/davide-frattesi/ \"Davide Frattesi\") in midfield.\n\nMeanwhile, the hosts will inevitably turn to Domenico Berardi for inspiration: the Neroverdi’s main man has notched 132 top-flight goals since 2013.\n\nSebastiano Esposito and Kieron Bowie must continue to fight for selection up front, while goalkeeper Arijanet Muric will hope to regain his place from Stefano Turati, after a third major error of the season saw him benched at the weekend.\n\nOnce again, Ismael Kone, Jay Idzes, Daniel Boloca and Belgian defender Fedde Leysen are all sidelined by injury; veteran midfielder Nemanja Matic should be available, despite being withdrawn early against Como due to fatigue.\n\n**Sassuolo possible starting lineup:**\n\nTurati; Cinquegrano, Caleta-Car, Odenthal, Doig; Lipani, Matic, Thorstvedt; Berardi, Esposito, Lauriente\n\n**Lazio possible starting lineup:**\n\nMandas; Floriani Mussolini, Sutalo, Doekhi, Tavares; Frattesi, Belahyane, Taylor; Isaksen, Noslin, Zaccagni\n\n* * success streak may come to an end - but their undefeated run will roll on. \n\nFor data analysis of the most likely results, scorelines and more for this match [please click \n\n[Lazio](/football/lazio/) \n\n# Preview: Sassuolo vs Lazio - prediction, team news, lineups\n\nBy [Jonathan O'Shea](/team/jonathan-oshea/) | 25 Oct 2026 07:51 \n\n![Sassuolo vs Lazio - prediction, team news, lineups](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/hIBe7Mo82b_3MHS7rjqTyGSQmAs=/720x540/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F10%2Fimago1083683346h-1-6ac899c6481a0970942711.jpg) \n\n© Imago / IPA Sport\n\n[Lazio](/football/lazio/ \"Lazio\") will look to extend their stunning start to the season on Tuesday evening, when they visit an ailing [Sassuolo](/football/sassuolo/ \"Sassuolo\") side in [**Serie A**](/football/serie-a/table.html).\n\nThe Biancocelesti are unbeaten in their first eight league games for the first time since the 1999-00 campaign, which they memorably ended by lifting the Scudetto.\n\n* * *\n\n## Match preview\n\nWith the Serie A summit up for grabs, Lazio went top of the pile on Saturday night, moving above defending champions Inter Milan with yet another home win.\n\nAfter the record-breaking Biancocelesti had beaten Juventus 3-0 in Turin, they conquered lowly Parma in Rome, with a 2-1 victory taking them onto 22 points from eight games.\n\nAlmost everything is going right at both ends of the pitch: [Gennaro Gattuso](/people/gennaro-gattuso/ \"Gennaro Gattuso\")’s side have scored at least twice in each of the last six, while only Inter have hit the woodwork more often.\n\nFurthermore, they are the only team yet to concede a first-half goal across all of Europe's top five leagues, [**and they boast the best defensive record in Italy’s top flight**](/football/serie-a/#stats).\n\nBefore heading to Reggio-Emilia, the last time Lazio failed to win on the road was May’s Derby della Capitale defeat to Roma - and they have won four of their last six Serie A meetings with Sassuolo.\n\n![](https://www.sportsmole.co.uk/thumbor/_rqmCP7lieCeg-vrHpnxzVV9rAs=/640x480/smart/filters:format\\(webp\\)/https%3A%2F%2Fsportsmole-media-prod.s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F08%2Fimago1081250242-1-6a881ba61a945168428900.jpg)\n\n© Imago / IPA Sport\n\nIf that were not enough to dishearten the Neroverdi, taking just one point from their last four matches may not help. \n\nFollowing a 4-2 defeat to newly promoted Frosinone and Saturday’s 2-0 reverse in Como, Sassuolo have slipped closer to the drop zone, with only eight points on the board so far.\n\nWhile few teams can deal with Como’s fluent football, the visitors attempted a mere seven shots at Stadio Sinigaglia, none of which found the target.\n\nSassuolo have also failed to keep a clean sheet in Serie A, so aside from a Coppa Italia run - they will meet Juventus for a last-16 tie in December - [Alberto Aquilani](/people/alberto-aquilani/ \"Alberto Aquilani\")'s reign has been a little below par.\n\nSince taking charge, he has yet to register an away win - and the Neroverdi’s winless streak on the road dates back 11 games overall - but Aquilani’s side are still undefeated at home.\n\nSassuolo Serie A form:\n\n* Imago / Gribaudi/ImagePhoto  \n Lazio were already missing Albert Gudmundsson with a dislocated shoulder, before fellow forward Andrea Pinamonti - signed from Sassuolo this summer - was ruled out of Saturday’s game by a fever.\n\nIt remains to be seen if either will be ready to play at the Mapei Stadium, while Adam Marusic and Nicolo Rovella could also miss out.\n\nAfter scoring the opener against Parma, and ending a 13-game goal drought in Serie A, Kenneth Taylor should join former Sassuolo star [Davide Frattesi](/people/davide-frattesi/ \"Davide Frattesi\") in midfield.\n\nMeanwhile, the hosts will inevitably turn to Domenico Berardi for inspiration: the Neroverdi’s main man has notched 132 top-flight goals since 2013.\n\nSebastiano Esposito and Kieron Bowie must continue to fight for selection up front, while goalkeeper Arijanet Muric will hope to regain his place from Stefano Turati, after a third major error of the season saw him benched at the weekend.\n\nOnce again, Ismael Kone, Jay Idzes, Daniel Boloca and Belgian defender Fedde Leysen are all sidelined by injury; veteran midfielder Nemanja Matic should be available, despite being withdrawn early against Como due to fatigue.\n\n**Sassuolo possible starting lineup:**\n\nTurati; Cinquegrano, Caleta-Car, Odenthal, Doig; Lipani, Matic, Thorstvedt; Berardi, Esposito, Lauriente\n\n**Lazio possible starting lineup:**\n\nMandas; Floriani Mussolini, Sutalo, Doekhi, Tavares; Frattesi, Belahyane, Taylor; Isaksen, Noslin, Zaccagni\n\n* *
